description: Wire the FEAT-001 foundation into the UI to satisfy all three Issue #18 acceptance criteria: (1) a star toggle to favorite/unfavorite a team (keyboard-accessible, localized); (2) a NON-color-only highlight of a favorite team's series in the bracket (icon AND border/outline, with an aria/visually-hidden label); (3) a header pin showing each favorite's next game / current series status, switching to an 'Eliminated' indication when the favorite lost a final series; plus a filter toggle to show only favorite teams' series with a friendly empty state. Everything EN/JA and accessible. Must NOT regress the #22 SeriesCard roving-tabindex/keyboard model nor the #17 refresh bar / #20 UpcomingGames UI.
steps: Add a reusable, accessible star toggle. Create frontend/src/components/FavoriteToggle.tsx: a <button type="button"> that reads useFavorites(), shows a filled star (favorited) or outline star (not), toggles on click, has aria-pressed reflecting favorited state, and a localized aria-label via t('favorites.add'|'favorites.remove', { team: teamName(t, teamId) }). The star glyph must be a real icon (inline SVG or a clearly-styled char) with its own non-color cue (filled vs outline shape), not color alone. Accept a size prop. Keep it keyboard-focusable (native button).

Place the FavoriteToggle on each team row. In frontend/src/components/SeriesCard.tsx TeamRow, render a <FavoriteToggle teamId={team.teamId}/> next to the TeamBadge/name. CRITICAL: do not break the card's roving-tabindex keyboard model from #22 - the card's handleKeyDown already bails out when event.target !== event.currentTarget, so a button inside the card keeps its native Enter/Space/click behavior and the card will not double-activate; verify this still holds (the toggle lives inside the <article>). Do not add a card-body onClick. Also add a FavoriteToggle to each row in frontend/src/components/StandingsPanel.tsx (next to the TeamBadge) so teams can be favorited from the standings too.

Highlight a favorite's series in the bracket WITHOUT relying on color alone (Issue #18 acceptance criterion 1). In SeriesCard, compute isFavoriteSeries = series includes any favorited team (use useFavorites + the team ids on the card, or a passed-in prop). When true, add a class (e.g. 'series-card--favorite') that applies a DISTINCT BORDER/OUTLINE and render a small star/flag ICON marker in the card header, AND add a visually-hidden or aria text via t('favorites.marker') so screen readers announce it is a favorite team's series. The visual cue must be perceivable in grayscale (border thickness/style + icon shape), not just a color change. Preserve existing selected/winner styling and dark-mode contrast (#22) - add styles in frontend/src/styles.css using existing CSS custom properties / data-theme so both themes stay AA. If a favorite in that series has been eliminated (isTeamEliminated), reflect an 'eliminated' treatment on that team's row/marker (e.g. a localized 'Eliminated'/'敗退' badge via t('favorites.eliminated')) - acceptance criterion 2.

Add the header pin. In frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx, below the brand/controls (and only in the state.status==='ready' && bracketStarted branch, or render-nothing otherwise), add a favorites summary region labeled t('favorites.header.title'). For each favorited team id, compute favoriteSummary(bracket, teamId): if inBracket===false render nothing for that team (favorite not in the selected season's bracket); if eliminated render the localized 'Eliminated'/'敗退' status (criterion 2); if champion render the champion status; otherwise render the current/next series status (round + leading/trailing/tied record, or next scheduled game time reusing frontend/src/gameTime.ts formatStartTime + resolveTimeZone). Use the TeamBadge + teamName for identity. Render NOTHING (no empty box) when there are no favorites or none are in this bracket. Keep it from throwing when a favorite id is unknown (teamName already yields a localized placeholder).

Add the favorites filter. In HomePage, add a toggle control (a checkbox or aria-pressed button) labeled t('favorites.filter.label') near the season nav / refresh bar. When ON, pass a flag (e.g. favoritesOnly) into BracketView so buildRoundColumns output is filtered to series that include at least one favorite team (filter in BracketView AFTER buildRoundColumns, keeping the roving-tabindex clamp logic intact - the active-cell clamp already handles a shrunken grid, mirroring the season-switch case). When the filter is ON and no favorite has a series in the current bracket, render a friendly localized empty state via t('favorites.filter.empty') INSTEAD of an empty grid. The filter must coexist with the season selector (switching seasons keeps the toggle state; the empty state appears if the new season has no favorite series). Keep the toggle keyboard-accessible and localized.

Add CSS for the new elements to frontend/src/styles.css: .series-card--favorite border/outline treatment (works in light+dark via data-theme vars), the star marker, the FavoriteToggle button (filled vs outline star), the eliminated badge, the header pin region, and the filter toggle. Reuse existing custom properties; verify dark-mode contrast is not regressed.

Add component tests: frontend/src/components/FavoriteToggle.test.tsx (renders, aria-pressed toggles, localized aria-label EN+JA, clicking toggles favorites state) rendered inside FavoritesProvider+I18nProvider; extend frontend/src/components/SeriesCard.test.tsx to assert the favorite highlight class + marker + aria text appear when a team is favorited and that the eliminated badge shows for a lost-final favorite; add a HomePage-level or BracketView-level test for the filter (only favorite series shown when ON; empty-state text shown when ON and no favorite series) and for the header pin (shows active status for an active favorite, 'Eliminated'/'敗退' for an eliminated favorite, nothing when no favorites). Use the test providers and fixtures from FEAT-001; assert the existing SeriesCard keyboard test (#22) still passes unchanged.

Add/extend Playwright e2e: create frontend/e2e/favorites.spec.ts using the existing stubBracket2026 helper (SAMPLE_2026_BRACKET already has an in-progress WS Dodgers 119 vs Yankees 147 = active favorite, and a FINAL ALCS where Astros 117 beat Mariners 136 => 136 is an eliminated favorite). Flow: load /season/2026, favorite a team via its star toggle, assert the bracket shows the non-color highlight MARKER (locate by class/role, not color) and the header pin appears with the active status; favorite the eliminated team (136) and assert the localized 'Eliminated'/'敗退' label appears in the pin and/or highlight; toggle the favorites filter and assert only favorite-team series remain (and that toggling it with a non-participating favorite shows the empty-state text). Cover at least one language explicitly (JA default and/or switch to EN). Keep selectors structural/localized like the other specs.
Run the full build, unit tests, e2e, and synth to confirm everything is green and nothing regressed.
acceptance_criteria: A keyboard-accessible, localized (EN+JA) star toggle lets a user favorite/unfavorite a team from SeriesCard team rows and StandingsPanel rows; aria-label is like 'Add {team} to favorites' / '{team}をお気に入りに追加' and aria-pressed reflects state.

Issue #18 criterion 1: a favorite team's series is highlighted with a NON-color cue - a star/flag icon AND a distinct border/outline - plus a visually-hidden/aria label ('Favorite team's series' / 'お気に入りチームのシリーズ'); perceivable in grayscale and AA-contrast in both light and dark themes.
Issue #18 criterion 2: an eliminated favorite (lost a final series) shows a localized 'Eliminated'/'敗退' indication in BOTH the header pin and the bracket highlight instead of an active status.

The header pin shows each in-bracket favorite's current/next series status (round + record, or next game time) and renders nothing when there are no favorites or a favorite is not in the selected season's bracket.

A localized filter toggle shows only favorite teams' series; when ON with no favorite series in the current bracket it shows a friendly localized empty state; it coexists with the season selector without fighting it.
Issue #18 criterion 3: every new string is EN/JA.
The #22 SeriesCard roving-tabindex/keyboard model and the #17 refresh bar / #20 UpcomingGames UI are unregressed (their existing tests still pass).
`npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run test:e2e -w frontend`, and `npm run synth` all pass.
verification: PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm test (all workspace vitest suites pass, including new FavoriteToggle/SeriesCard/HomePage/BracketView favorites tests and the unchanged #22 keyboard test)

PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run test:e2e -w frontend (Playwright headless chromium; favorites.spec.ts and all existing specs pass; run `npx playwright install chromium` once first if the browser is missing)
PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" npm run synth (frontend build + cdk synth, no AWS calls, passes as a regression guard)
